messages:
maria: Heads-up: RFC approved to replace the verbose `X-Redwood-Route` header with a compact header `x-rd-route`. Goal: smaller headers for embedded devices, more consistent SDK encoding, and simpler parsing in the routing layer. RFC: github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/82

kevin: Do we have a compatibility plan? lots of customers pin old SDKs and some air-gapped users won't update quickly.

maria: Yes. Server will accept both formats for a 90-day window. We'll emit a deprecation metric when the long header is used. SDKs should add a toggle to opt into compact by default during a minor release cadence.

sylvia: Console concern: dashboards currently group by the decoded route string derived from the long header. If compact encodes differently we could split charts. Need a canonicalization plan.

jonathan: We can add `route.id` into traces/metrics at the routing edge after decoding either header. That canonical id will be used by quota and console. Also add `route.header_variant` tag (long|compact).

kevin: SDK work: Python/TS/Go need examples and an env var to opt-in. Suggest: RD_ROUTE_MODE=compact|legacy to make testing easier. Also a ClientConfig flag `use_compact_route=true` for programmatic control.

maria: Sounds good. Timeline idea: Week 0 announce + doc; Week 1-3 opt-in SDK releases + staging canary; Week 4 flip default in the SDK minor; Week 8 disable long-header acceptance unless we hit regressions.

sylvia: For the console backfill: we'll run a migration stage in the metrics pipeline mapping old decoded-strings -> `route.id`. I can add a UI banner explaining the migration window and provide a manual mapping UI in case two old routes collide into one id.

kevin: Quick snippet for reviewers — Py + TS + Go so devs can copy: 
```python
# python old
headers = {"X-Redwood-Route": "env:svc:shard-2"}
# python new
headers = {"x-rd-route": "c2VydmljZToyOjI="}  # compact token
client.request(..., headers=headers)
```
```ts
// ts old
const headers = { 'X-Redwood-Route': 'env:svc:shard-2' }
// ts new
const headers = { 'x-rd-route': 'c2VydmljZToz' }
await client.request(payload, { headers })
```
```go
// go old
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Route", "env:svc:shard-2")
// go new
req.Header.Set("x-rd-route", "c2VydmljZToz")
```

jonathan: Platform: I'll wire `route.id` into the trace envelope and add metric `route.header_variant.count{variant}`. Quota allocator will prefer `route.id` for ledger keys to avoid double counting when both headers are seen.

ops-bot: Canary deployment started: router-service v2024.11.2-canary -> staging (5% traffic) at 2024-08-02T09:12:00Z

sylvia: I'll open a console ticket for the banner + backfill job: internal/UX-452. Adding a small admin mapping page to resolve collisions.

maria: Devex should draft migration guide with clear upgrade steps, sample code, and rollback notes. Kevin, can you lead that?

kevin: I'll draft the guide and include a compatibility table showing server acceptance window, SDK opt-in flags, and expected metric names. Draft PR: github.com/redwood/devex/pulls/1401 (WIP).

maria: A couple of gotchas: 1) If clients send both headers we should define precedence. 2) Logging must redact route tokens in customer-facing logs.

jonathan: Precedence: if `route.id` present in trace envelope use it; else if both headers present, prefer `x-rd-route` (compact) but emit a warning metric. And yes, token redaction will be applied at ingress log filter.

kevin: For SDK versioning: plan minor release that introduces `use_compact_route` default=false, document it. After the canary and 6 weeks of metrics, release a follow-up minor where default=true, and keep opt-out for two minor cycles before removal.

sylvia: Console migration note: historical metrics will be backfilled but label cardinality might spike during migration. We'll throttle the backfill to avoid query overload.

maria: Action list captured:
- devex (@kevin): migration guide + py/ts/go snippets + changelog entries
- platform (@jonathan): emit `route.id` + header_variant metric + quota precedence change
- console (@sylvia): banner, backfill job, admin mapping UI
- infra/ops: accept both headers for 90 days, run canary 5% -> 25% -> full

kevin: Opening the SDK PRs today with example code and RD_ROUTE_MODE env var. Will ping here when drafts up.

jonathan: PR: github.com/redwood/platform/pulls/9922 (route.id + metrics). Running unit tests now.

sylvia: Filed UX ticket: internal/UX-452. Added mockups for the banner and admin mapping flow.

maria: Thanks — keeping thread open for updates and PR links. :thumbsup:
